admitted.title: A bare-ticker portfolio lot is re-priced against a different listing when the session region changes: INFY 20 @ Rs1,500 shows -$29,779.20 (-99.26%) under region US, and the CSV export carries it

NSE SME GSTL (Globesecure Technologies) is stamped with BSE GSTL Globalspace Technologies' ISIN INE632W01016 / scrip 540654, so its results calendar, announcements, corporate actions and shareholding split merge a different company's BSE filings

After the exchange-filed overlay replaces EPS, P/E stays on the provider EPS the payload says is not served (SUNRAJDI P/E 155.5 beside served EPS 0.23 at 12.44; true ~54), the flag reason quotes a third implied P/E 141.1, and the copilot tells the user the 155.5 'is indeed right'

Deep brief for FOCUS (Focus Lighting and Fixtures) states unrelated common-word headlines (Flydubai pilot podcast 'Focus on flying', European shares 'focus on inflation data') as the company's own sentiment and strategy

Every NSE Emerge (SME) listing has no fundamentals: /fundamentals 404s telling the user to check the symbol, and income/balance return empty 200s with no reason (YASHOPTICS, SUMAX, QUALIANCE, GANESHIN, VOLERCAR)

Portfolio quote fan-out wedges the sidecar: per-symbol /quotes GETs abort at the 30 s client budget, the in-flight guard releases on the abort while the server keeps working, and each tick re-requests every symbol (0/100 resolved over 210 s; RELIANCE quote >40 s on the same sidecar)

With the Portfolio panel closed, get_portfolio stamps every non-crypto holding with the session region's currency, so a USD AAPL lot is served to the agent as currency INR and the copilot states 'AAPL - 2 shares, cost basis Rs190'

A corrupt SQLite store is never quarantined: a corrupt data_cache.db (pure cache) fails sidecar startup on every launch, and a corrupt custom_agents.db / delegate_runs.db / plugins.db 500s every route of that store until the file is deleted by hand
AMAL (NSE, the default IN bind) serves market_cap and shares_outstanding unavailable while the same ISIN on BSE (AMAL.BO) serves both in the same sidecar
SIFY analyst revenue estimate (USD-sized 191.7M) is labelled revenue_currency INR, a ~64x understatement against Sify's quarterly revenue INR 12,352 M, and the Earnings estimate grid renders it

Symbol autocomplete never offers the BSE company of a same-ticker collision: 'Zeal Aqua', 'Sanathnagar Enterprises', ZEAL.BO and SEL.BO return only the NSE namesake or nothing, though /resolve binds the BSE company

RELIANCE.BO earnings history is two quarters stale against the NSE listing of the same company (latest 2025-12-31 vs 2026-06-30) and its analyst consensus differs (36 vs 26 analysts), with no staleness or listing-basis note
'Should I buy Amal Ltd?' on gpt-4o-mini gets a buy lean justified by an industry P/E comparison no tool fetched
Ollama lane: a tool call leaked as a Python-literal dict (None/True/False) is not rescued; the raw call blob is shown as the assistant reply
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md lists the wrong version for 56 of 121 main-sidecar Python components because transitive deps are unpinned and the bundle ships what pip resolved at build time
arrange_layout custom reports success ('Arranged sec_filings_list' / 'Arranged your panels') when no panel token resolves and the layout is unchanged
A holding whose symbol answers 404 raises the transport-failure banner 'Couldn't refresh live quotes' with a Retry that can never succeed, and the 404 is re-requested every 5 s
With the ULTRA slider one user turn fans out into N sequential full ULTRA heavy runs (4 research calls -> ~19 min, ~$1.25, each brief replacing the last)

Settings SearXNG card tells a user whose Docker/OrbStack is installed but stopped that Docker 'isn't available' and to install it, ignoring docker.cli_present/daemon_running and the sidecar's 'start Docker/OrbStack' detail
Keyless web search: the Brave engine (impersonated fetch) gets HTTP 429 while a plain-UA curl from the same host gets 200 in the same minute, so keyless web_search returns zero rows on this network
docs/SIDECAR_API.md ('the contract') documents 20 of 111 live routes and states an allow-all-origins CORS posture, a 501 macro hook and stub routers that the running sidecar contradicts
R12_HAND_TESTING_GUIDE.md, the only hand-testing guide, walks an order-placement 'safety showcase', a brokers plugin and a paper portfolio removed by D81
RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md step 1 tells the operator to merge the superseded worktree-agent-r15-version-0.9.0 branch although the 0.9.0 bump is already in the sha
Ownership witness flags a near-agreeing institutions figure with a false reason: Yahoo 0.00% vs filed 0.03% (AMAL) is flagged 'disagrees ... beyond 3pp'
DEEP research overran its 180 s wall budget by 79 s (259 s) on the local lane: the final synthesis call is not boxed by the remaining wall
Screener freshness line prints unrounded float seconds ('quotes 41.64699196815491s ago')
News titles keep raw HTML entities: the News Feed shows 'F&O Talk: ...' literally (and the agent news tool gets the same)
A bundle sidecar that cannot bind its port dies with SIGABRT (exit 134, Fatal Python error _enter_buffered_busy on the stdin watchdog) instead of a clean non-zero exit
transform.code size caps are bypassed by sum(list, start): a 25-character expression builds an uncapped list (8.3 GB peak RSS) and keeps running after the 5 s timeout
write_note files a note under the literal company name ('COCHIN SHIPYARD') instead of the ticker, so the symbol's note view (COCHINSHIP) stays empty
delete_workspace leaves <name>.vysted-workspace.bak behind, so a later corrupt-file recovery of a same-named workspace resurrects the deleted workspace's content
A local-model narrative written with markdown-bold headers (**TAKE** / **BULL** ...) collapses to a flat summary + insights; the five typed fields come back empty
A whitespace-only Avg cost saves the holding at cost basis 0, and a hex quantity '0x10' saves as 16
Brief header reads 'web + structured data' directly above the 'Structured data only - no web sources found' banner on a filings-only brief
MCP_INTEGRATION.md names 25 tools; the live MCP surface lists 39
CURRENT_STATE.md cites a missing build report, the deleted monte_carlo.py and an absent ConnectCard.tsx, and reports 0.8.0 and 619 vitest / 942 pytest
RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md's 'verbatim' ci-local block differs from package.json ci-local
MCP discovery file advertises protocol 2025-06-18 while /mcp/status reports 2025-11-25; the Rust sync comment points at a constant that does not exist

humanize() classifies by HTTP status alone, so users get a next step that cannot work: OpenAI no-credit 429 and free-model shared-pool 429 say 'wait a minute', invalid Gemini/xAI keys (400), invalid model ids (400) and context overflow (400/413) say 'try again', a stopped Ollama says 'check your network'

Data-source description is hand-maintained in marketplace.ts, disconnected from provider_registry and the plugin contract, and has already drifted (yfinance entry lists 3 keys vs 7 served; nse_direct/nse/bse/ccxt have no entry); adding a source needs host edits in two languages
Verifier verdict text wrapped in underscore emphasis (_UNVERIFIED_ / __UNVERIFIED__) parses as AGREE
strip_model_bibliography misses common bibliography heading variants, so a model-written source list survives beside the verified one
A Gemini free-tier per-minute 429 (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED ... retry in Ns) is shown as "out of credit or quota. Add credit or check your plan"
historyForSend drops the oldest turns once the thread passes 60k chars with no notice to the user or the model
20-F ownership lane returns not_applicable with 0 holders for ADRs whose 20-F has a holders table (IBN, HDB)
FAST research web-only branch (no instrument resolves) awaits _web_round without a time box; only the resolved branch uses asyncio.wait_for
write_screener_filters with only the documented OR/nested group tree is rejected: schema requires criteria
Macro search failure renders as an empty "No matching series": the store catches every error and stores []; keyless FRED search is a 502 with an actionable message
Settings privacy copy over-promises: "Nothing leaves this machine except calls you make to providers you configure" while keyless lanes (Yahoo, NSE/BSE, DDG) call out without configuration
Screener formula validate accepts a boolean operand in a comparison ("roe > (pe_ratio < 15)", "(pe_ratio > 3) > 0.5") and coerces it
Analyst ratings swallow a Yahoo rate-limit into an empty 200 list that reads as no coverage
A Yahoo rate-limit on earnings history is swallowed as an empty history and cached for 24 h
Heavy/ULTRA brief stopped by its spend ceiling publishes note=None, and the cross-check keeps spending after the breach
The latest round's tool results are never elided by _fit_to_window, so a multi-result round leaves the answer below the 1/8 reserve
Scheduled and MCP-run workflows run with no event sink: action.notify_desktop reports notified:true but nothing is shown
Editing a custom agent silently clears its default_model on save (customSpecToSummary sets defaultModel: null)
A partially throttled screen shows "No rows matched - loosen a threshold / Reset filters" although most symbols were never evaluated
A focused SEC Filings panel publishes identifier, not symbol, so the agent context names the wrong symbol
Flaky test_research_fast::test_fast_web_round_runs_alongside_a_time_boxed_fan_out: an unstubbed earnings-quality leg makes it timing-dependent
ReasoningSplitter releases a held reasoning echo in full when an answer follows it (provisional, shard evidence only)
Agent/MCP compute_greeks and price_option return QuantLib-unit vega/theta/rho unlabelled; the model restated them as per-unit values
sp500 screen serves S&P 500 member PTC as PTC India Limited (INR) from a fundamentals row written before the LEAD-044 fix; no migration purges it
Screener top-K round-robin gives currency-less rows their own group slot, so a null-market-cap row displaces a real one
Earnings drill-down As-of chip shows the client fetch clock and ignores the envelope server as_of

No persistent store records a schema version (user_version 0 on all 8 SQLite DBs; no top-level workspace blob version) and nothing backs up the data dir before a new build touches it, so the first non-additive schema change will crash or silently drop data

A 200-status CAPTCHA/block page from a keyless engine is recorded as a healthy empty answer and resets that engine's circuit breaker, so a blocking engine is never benched and an all-blocked search reports 'found nothing' instead of 'rate-limited'
Screener 'Export CSV' writes the file but shows no saved path, toast or error (the result of downloadCsv is discarded)
sec-edgar-mcp is killed while still extracting on a cold or busy launch (~91 s) and /sec routes return 501 for the whole session

refuted.reason: Environment, not a product defect (R1b): OpenRouter free-pool 404/429 and DeepSeek 402 (unfunded) were each answered with humanized provider errors; probes recorded in scenarios/AC-1.md:20-23.
Local-model prose claim ('brief contains news') with no figure: outside the R4 figure class, and under R1b model prose not rendered as data; the structured card is correct.
Local-model invented ambiguity question with no figure: outside the R4 class; R1b model prose, the resolve result (KPITTECH) is correct and nothing renders it as data.
Local-model misreading of an ok tool result in prose, no figure: outside the R4 class; R1b model prose, not rendered as data.
